claims.text: "(a) Agreements .-Before entering a lease under section 1511(i) of the Armed Forces Retirement Home Act of 1991 ( 24 U.S.C. 411(i) ), the Chief Operating Officer of the Armed Forces Retirement Home may enter into an agreement with a potential lessee for such lease providing for a period of exclusivity, access, study, or for similar purposes. The agreement shall provide for the payment (in cash or in kind) by the potential lessee of consideration for the agreement unless the Chief Operating Officer determines that payment of consideration will not promote the purpose and financial stability of the Armed Forces Retirement Home or be in the public interest.
